tools.description: Admit and answer a typed question (QuestionIR) over the workspace's declared metrics, once, without saving it. The checker refuses a question that names undeclared metrics or mixes incompatible units, with the reason. Take the metric name and its object type from norn_question_catalog (a metric's type_params.metric_aggregation_params.semantic_model is the objectSet). Every field below is required; keep the window to the period asked about (a year at most), and add groupBy only when a breakdown is asked for: {"irVersion": "0.1", "name": "stock_now", "objectSet": "canon.Holding", "aggregate": [{"metric": "<metric name>"}], "groupBy": [], "filter": [], "window": {"start": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "end": "2026-12-01T00:00:00Z"}, "calendar": "iso_utc", "freshness": {"kind": "live", "maxAgeMs": 5000}}. Then trace a bucket with norn_trace_evaluated.

tools.description: Read one page of records of a type that the caller may see, optionally filtered and sorted. Filter: {"all": [{"property": p, "op": o, "value": v}]} with op one of eq, ne, in, contains, prefix, lt, lte, gt, gte, between (value [low, high]), empty, present; at most 8 clauses. Sort: "property:asc" or "property:desc", up to 3, comma-separated. Pass the page's `next` as `after` for the next page. Withheld values never match a filter.
